acceptance: Maintenance cannot self-certify authority and is fully cancellable/auditable.
verifiedBy: node --test tests/maintenance/maintenance-exec-contract.test.mjs tests/maintenance/maintenance-contract.test.mjs (5/5 pass, executed); 20 new deterministic Rust #[test] functions across engine/crates/membrane-supervisor/src/maintenance.rs and engine/crates/crypt-store/src/maintenance_exec.rs, written in this task's commit and left unexecuted pending cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace at the Wave 4 phased gate.
observed: Cannot self-certify: plan_maintenance (engine/crates/membrane-supervisor/src/maintenance.rs) rejects any request where the authority receipt's issuer_id equals the scheduler_id or whose subject_id does not equal the scheduler_id, disposing it Rejected/AuthoritySelfCertified before the caller-supplied 'verified' flag (which does not exist on the wire type) or any other self-assertion could matter -- tests rejects_when_issuer_equals_scheduler_self_certification and rejects_when_subject_does_not_match_scheduler. A separately-owned MaintenanceAuthorityVerifier must also independently confirm the receipt (rejects_when_verifier_declines_even_though_fields_look_valid), and scope/capability must match exactly (rejects_wrong_scope, rejects_when_authority_does_not_allow_requested_kind). The store-side executor (engine/crates/crypt-store/src/maintenance_exec.rs) grants nothing either: it contains no verifier trait or verify() function of its own (asserted by the new maintenance-exec-contract.test.mjs) and refuses to open a transaction without a non-empty caller-supplied authority_receipt_id (MaintenanceExecError::MissingAuthority, test refuses_to_run_without_an_authority_receipt_id) -- the receipt_id can only ever have originated from the planner's own independent check. Fully cancellable: the planner rejects any request with cancelled=true outright, before spending budget or touching authority (test rejects_a_cancelled_request_even_when_otherwise_valid). The executor polls is_cancelled() before every unit and, on a true result, rolls back the whole in-progress transaction instead of committing partial work; test cancellation_rolls_back_every_unit_this_invocation_applied proves zero rows persist after a mid-run cancellation. The same all-or-nothing transaction (commit only on a full pass; drop -> automatic SQLite rollback on any other outcome) also delivers the load-bearing crash-safety requirement: deadline_already_passed_never_touches_the_store, budget_exhaustion_rolls_back_the_units_already_applied_this_invocation, and a_failing_unit_rolls_back_units_that_already_succeeded each assert the scratch table holds zero rows after their respective interruption, proving the store is never observed in a partially-written state -- including across a hard crash, because an uncommitted transaction's frames are never checkpointed into the main SQLite database file. Auditable: every plan_maintenance call returns a MaintenanceReceipt carrying schema_version, disposition, a typed reason on rejection, and the authority_receipt_id (tests every_receipt_carries_the_declared_schema_version, rejected_receipts_still_carry_authority_receipt_id_for_the_audit_trail); every execute_bounded_maintenance call that passes the authority gate returns a MaintenanceExecReceipt recording outcome, units_offered, units_committed, and start/finish timestamps regardless of whether the run committed or rolled back (commits_every_unit_when_within_budget_and_deadline and all four rollback tests). Both receipt types are content-free by construction and by an explicit contract-test assertion (no content/document/embedding/path/result fields) -- they never carry document text, embeddings, or maintenance results, only disposition/outcome metadata for the audit trail. Status is recorded as pending_book_gate, not pass, per the book-mode execution rules: acceptance is finalized only at the Wave 4 phased gate (Gate phase 3.2) after cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace is run there.
